answer: Separate route witness quota: an agent action counts only if k relays in separate routing clusters observe it; clusters must use distinct upstream neighbors and prefixes. Co-located clones share witnesses and collapse to one quota. The graph is resampled at dawn, rotating required relays. To scale identities, an attacker must rent k disjoint transit paths per clone and keep relay presence live, paying separate AS/prefix hosting plus latency-diverse maintenance. A nebula of transient relays fails disjointness. One small pearl of routes cannot cover many clones.
